defsZh:
adv. 永久, 不變, 持久
[計] 永久性的

examples.en: You're still young, but not permanently.
examples.zh: 你還年輕，可是沒有永久。

examples.en: Alert, in Nunavut, Canada, is the northernmost permanently inhabited place in the world.
examples.zh: 加拿大努納武特地區的阿勒特是世界上最北端的永久居住地。

defsEn: for a long time without essential change

defsZh:
n. 犁
v. 犁, 耕
defsEn: a farm tool having one or more heavy blades to break the soil and cut a furrow prior to sowing

defsZh:
n. 疑問, 疑問號, 質問, 查詢
v. 詢問, 質問
[計] 查詢

examples.en: Any further queries should be made via the customer service number below.
examples.zh: 如有任何其他疑問，請撥打下方的客服電話。

examples.en: I do have a parting query.

defsEn: an instance of questioning

defsZh:
n. 鐵路, 軌道
[經] 鐵路

examples.en: My dad works on the railways.
Don't go over the railway tracks!

defsEn: line that is the commercial organization responsible for operating a system of transportation for trains that pull passengers or freight

defsZh: n. 雨衣

examples.en: You'd better put on a raincoat.
You had better put on a raincoat.
Who's the girl in a yellow raincoat?
examples.zh: 穿黃色雨衣的女孩是誰？

defsEn: a water-resistant coat

defsZh: v. 再考慮, 重新考慮

examples.en: The stage charisma of drag performers compels audiences to reconsider their own stereotypes.
examples.zh: 反串秀者的舞臺魅力使觀眾不禁重新審視自己的刻板印象。

defsEn: consider again; give new consideration to; usually with a view to changing

defsZh: [化] 重新設計
defsEn: design anew, make a new design for

defsZh:
n. 預演, 排演, 練習, 敘述, 複述
[法] 詳述, 列舉事實, 複述

examples.en: Tomorrow there will be no normal lessons, in view of the athletic meet rehearsal.
examples.zh: 明天是運動會的排練，沒有往常的課程。

examples.en: Lately there have been constant dance rehearsals; Performances will be on Friday and Saturday.
examples.zh: 最近一直在舞蹈排練，週五週六要演出啊。

defsEn: a practice session in preparation for a public performance (as of a play or speech or concert)

defsZh:
n. 鬆弛, 放鬆, 減輕, 緩和, 休息, 休養
[化] 鬆弛; 馳豫

examples.en: What do you do for relaxation?

defsEn: (physiology) the gradual lengthening of inactive muscle or muscle fibers

defsZh:
n. 重複, 背誦, 迴圈, 複製品, 副本
[機] 重複, 反覆

examples.en: Repetition is the mother of memory.
A single repetition is not enough.

defsEn: an event that repeats

defsZh:
n. 休息寓所, 撤退, 隱居, 退避
vi. 撤退, 隱退, 向後傾
vt. 退(棋)

examples.en: The snail retreated into its shell.
They had no alternative but to retreat.
The soldiers retreated from their positions.
examples.zh: 士兵們撤離了他們的陣地。

defsEn: (military) withdrawal of troops to a more favorable position to escape the enemy's superior forces or after a defeat

defsZh: n. 大會客室, 大廳, 客廳, 交誼室, 沙龍, 美術展覽館, 畫廊, 美容院, 髮廊

examples.en: Mary works at a nail salon.

defsEn: gallery where works of art can be displayed

defsZh:
n. 人造衛星
[醫] 伴行靜脈, 陪靜脈, 陪病部, 隨體, 衛星

examples.en: The satellite came flying over Hanoi.
examples.zh: 人造衛星從河內上空飛過。

defsEn: man-made equipment that orbits around the earth or the moon

defsZh: n. 風景, 景色, 舞臺佈景

examples.en: I need a change of scenery.

defsEn: the painted structures of a stage set that are intended to suggest a particular locale

defsZh:
n. 分期連載作品, 連載小說
a. 連續的, 一連串的, 連載的, 分期償還的
[計] 連續的; 序列的

examples.en: Tom had no idea Mary was a serial killer.
examples.zh: 湯姆不知道瑪麗是個連環殺手。

examples.en: They have watched TV serials this evening.
examples.zh: 他們今晚看了電視連續劇。

defsEn: a serialized set of programs

defsZh:
vt. 縫紉, 縫合, 縫
vi. 縫紉

examples.en: Did you sew this by hand?
Do you have a sewing needle?
I bought a new sewing machine.
examples.zh: 我買了一臺新的縫紉機。

defsEn: fasten by sewing; do needlework

defsZh:
n. 素描, 草圖, 小品
v. 描繪略圖, 畫素描或速寫

examples.en: Jiro made a sketch of Mt. Fuji.
examples.zh: 次郎畫了一幅富士山的素描。

examples.en: Tom ripped a page out of his sketch book.
examples.zh: 湯姆從他的繪畫本上撕下了一頁。

defsEn: preliminary drawing for later elaboration

defsZh: n. 智慧手機

examples.en: I still don't have a smartphone.

defsZh:
n. 高揚, 翱翔
vi. 往上飛舞, 高聳, 翱翔

examples.en: The birds soar in the air.
The value of the yen has soared.

defsEn: the act of rising upward into the air

defsZh:
n. 刺激, 激勵, 刺激品
[醫] 刺激特, 刺激
defsEn: any stimulating information or event; acts to arouse action

defsZh: n. 股票經紀人
defsEn: an agent in the buying and selling of stocks and bonds

defsZh: n. 檯布

examples.en: The tablecloth is in the cabinet.

defsEn: a covering spread over a dining table

defsZh: a. 口渴的, 渴望的, 乾燥的
defsEn: needing moisture

defsZh:
n. 震顫, 激動, 刺激性, 一陣激動
vi. 震顫, 顫抖, 激動
vt. 使激動, 使顫動

examples.en: I'd be thrilled to do that.

defsEn: the swift release of a store of affective force

defsZh:
n. 磚瓦, 瓷磚, 瓦片
vt. 鋪以瓦, 鋪以瓷磚
[計] 平鋪

examples.en: How many tiles do you need?
Do you know how to tile?

defsEn: a flat thin rectangular slab (as of fired clay or rubber or linoleum) used to cover surfaces

defsZh:
n. 化妝用品, 梳妝用具, 化妝用具
[化] 化妝用品

examples.en: Most hotels these days provide free toiletries for showering.

defsEn: artifacts used in making your toilet (washing and taking care of your body)

defsZh:
n. 商標
[法] 商標

examples.en: I think that is his trademark.

defsEn: a distinctive characteristic or attribute

defsZh:
a. 熱帶的, 熱情的
[醫] 熱帶的

examples.en: This kind of plant grows only in the tropical regions.
examples.zh: 這類植物只生長在熱帶地區。

defsEn: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)

defsZh: n. 金槍魚, 金槍魚肉

examples.en: Japanese people like to eat tuna.
Tom got mercury poisoning from eating canned tuna every day.
examples.zh: Tom汞中毒，因為他每天吃罐裝鮪魚。

examples.en: The skin of a shark is much rougher than that of a tuna fish.
examples.zh: 鯊魚的皮比鮪魚的皮粗糙多了。

defsEn: tropical American prickly pear of Jamaica

defsZh:
a. 失業的, 未被利用的
[經] 沒有被僱用的, 失業的, 沒有被利用的

examples.en: I hear that the number of the unemployed has been increasing recently.
examples.zh: 聽說最近失業者人數正在增加

defsEn: not engaged in a gainful occupation

defsZh:
vt. 使有效, 使生效, 確認, 證實, 驗證
[計] 驗證

examples.en: How do I validate my card?

defsEn: declare or make legally valid

defsZh: n. 香草, 香子蘭

examples.en: She made a vanilla chocolate cake for four people.
examples.zh: 她做了一個四人份的巧克力香草蛋糕。

examples.en: If and only if the ice-cream is vanilla flavour will Xiao Wang eat it.
examples.zh: 當且僅當冰淇淋是香草口味，小王會吃這個冰淇淋。

defsEn: any of numerous climbing plants of the genus Vanilla having fleshy leaves and clusters of large waxy highly fragrant white or green or topaz flowers

defsZh: n. 樂意, 心甘情願, 願意

examples.en: I thank you for your willingness.
Dick showed a willingness to help us.
Tom has expressed a willingness to help.

defsEn: cheerful compliance

defsZh: n. 手錶
defsEn: a watch that is worn strapped to the wrist

defsZh:
vi. 停留, 遵守, 居留, 繼續下去
vt. 忍受, 經受, 屈從於

examples.en: We have to abide by the rules.
You have to abide by the laws.

defsEn: dwell

defsZh: adv. 活躍地, 積極地
defsEn: in an active manner

defsZh:
n. 變應性, 反感, 厭惡
[化] 變態反應; 變應性

examples.en: I have an allergy to milk.

defsEn: hypersensitivity reaction to a particular allergen; symptoms can vary greatly in intensity

defsZh: a. 惴惴不安的, 敏悟的, 知曉的
defsEn: quick to understand; - Nathaniel Hawthorne

defsZh: a. 汽車的

examples.en: Let's talk about the automotive industry in Algeria.
Fiat is a historic brand in the Italian automotive industry.
The Chinese automotive import market shows signs of slight growth.

defsEn: of or relating to motor vehicles

defsZh:
pl. 細菌
[醫] 細菌, [無芽胞]桿菌

examples.en: A cell phone is as contaminated with bacteria as a toilet is.
examples.zh: 手機如同馬桶一樣被細菌汙染。

examples.en: Bacteria are so small that they cannot be seen with the naked eye.
examples.zh: 細菌微小到無法用肉眼看到。

defsEn: (microbiology) single-celled or noncellular spherical or spiral or rod-shaped organisms lacking chlorophyll that reproduce by fission; important as pathogens and for biochemical properties; taxonomy is difficult; often considered to be plants
